description: Bitcoin: Find on-chain metrics by plain words: MVRV, realized price, SOPR, NUPL, supply held by long-term or short-term holders, coin age, addresses by balance, hashrate, fees, volume, and thousands more. Start here for any metric question: it returns the series ids to pass to `get_series_latest` or `get_series`. Results prioritize whole query words in names, then descriptions, then fuzzy names, then fuzzy descriptions. Word order does not matter. Descriptions provide cohort terminology and formulas. The decoded q parameter is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

q.description: Words to find in series names and descriptions (`realized price`, `mvrv`), in any order
